notes:
Summary: Mid-market product-analytics SaaS. Started with Hosted API POC for embeddings + in-product chat; POC showed good quality but variability at scale. Decided Dedicated for predictable latency, data isolation and VPC requirement. Current stage: procurement/legal for Dedicated.

POC details: seeded 10k documents, used hosted embeddings + reranking; achieved p50 ~120ms but cost per query higher than target when scaled to 1M queries/month. Team flagged need for prefix/KV caching and batching suggestions from Redwood Optimize.

Security & compliance: require SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs, SOC2 Type II evidence. EU customers require data residency - legal wants explicit DPA residency clause. Infosec: "Need on-prem-like controls without heavy ops" (CTO quote).

Legal/Procurement notes: Received Redwood MSA + DPA. We returned redlines focused on indemnity, liability caps, and specific DPA residency text for EU controllers. Also requested SLA clarifications: uptime SLA 99.9% and token-level latency SLOs (p50/p95 for generation and embeddings). Procurement wants vendor onboarding packet + SOC2 Type II report before PO.

Commercials: Redwood pricing (reserved capacity + bursts) under evaluation. Finance modeling ARR 50K-150K based on projected usage. Wants clearer overage mechanics and minimum commitment tiers.

Operational items: SE (Liam) to provide dedicated capacity sizing worksheet and recommended autoscaling policy. Engineering asked for runbook for failover to hosted fallback model variant.

Next steps: 1) Redwood legal to respond to MSA/DPA redlines (indemnity/liability and residency) 2) SE to share Dedicated capacity plan + SLA appendix 3) Procurement to receive SOC2 Type II report and vendor questionnaire answers 4) Aim to close in 2026-03 (forecast).
